cases.input: A monitoring alert fires without an authorized declaration.
cases.expect: Reject incident creation; retain the external observation or alert.

cases.input: One outage is entered as peer operational and cyber incident masters.
cases.expect: Reject the second declaration; retain one governing declaration and one QualificationReference or mirror correspondence with the same occurrenceRef.

cases.input: A separate cyber record claims the same occurrence without correspondence evidence.
cases.expect: Reject the record as an ungoverned duplicate.

cases.input: Three declarations reference one persistent Problem.
cases.expect: All incident identities and the Problem identity remain distinct.

cases.input: Rollback restores service while a suspected defect and permanent-fix task remain open.
cases.expect: Incident may restore or close under its own authority; Problem, Defect and permanent task remain open.

cases.input: Incident closure attempts to close its Problem and all tasks.
cases.expect: Reject every cross-aggregate cascade.

cases.input: A restoration task completes and the Problem is auto-closed.
cases.expect: Reject Problem closure without its own authority.

cases.input: A RootCauseClaim is asserted without evidence or confidence.
cases.expect: Reject the incomplete claim.

cases.input: One supported claim and one disputed claim address the same Problem.
cases.expect: Retain both addressable claims with separate evidence confidence and status.

cases.input: A supported claim overwrites a prior disputed claim.
cases.expect: Reject overwrite and append the new claim or status transition.

cases.input: A cause claim is assigned the defect identifier.
cases.expect: Reject identity collapse and retain a version-pinned defect reference.

cases.input: Severity changes after new impact evidence.
cases.expect: Append a superseding assessment and preserve the prior one.

cases.input: Task priority is silently set from incident severity.
cases.expect: Reject the derived priority without its own assertion.

cases.input: Potential customer impact is later verified as actual.
cases.expect: Retain separate revisioned ImpactAssessment records.

cases.input: Problem impact is computed as authoritative from incident children without a rule.
cases.expect: Reject implicit roll-up.

cases.input: Incident is closed after recovery while permanent remediation remains unfinished.
cases.expect: Keep remediation Task and Problem open and preserve the closure evidence.

cases.input: A closed incident recurs and is reopened.
cases.expect: Append transition and preserve all earlier impact resolution and review records.

cases.input: Detection observation and declaration are stored as one timestamp.
cases.expect: Reject loss of clock semantics.
